function AdventureActivityMainWindow:_OnUpdateContent(msg)
  local itemType = msg.New:GetCode()
  local oriEnergyBoostNum
  if self.m_model:GetBoardModel():IsEnergyModuleOpen() then
    oriEnergyBoostNum = #self.m_model:GetBoardModel():GetEnergyModel():GetListUnlockExponent()
  end
  local updated, unlockedFog = self.m_model:UpdateLevel(itemType, msg.New)
  if not updated then
    return
  end
  local canScroll, moveRows = self.m_boardScrollComponentLuaTable:CheckScroll()
  if canScroll or unlockedFog then
    GM.UIManager:SetEventLock(true, self)
  end
  local seq = DOTween.Sequence()
  seq:AppendCallback(function()
    self.m_levelProgress:PlayProgressAnimation(0.9)
  end)
  seq:AppendInterval(0.9)
  seq:AppendCallback(function()
    if not self.m_levelProgress.gameObject:IsNull() then
      self.m_levelProgress:UpdateLevelContent(true)
    end
  end)
  seq:AppendInterval(0.2)
  seq:AppendCallback(function()
    if not self.m_closed and not self.gameObject:IsNull() then
      local level = self.m_model:GetLevel()
      if 1 <= level and level ~= self.m_model:GetMergeLength() then
        GM.AudioModel:PlayEffect(AudioFileConfigName.sfxItemUnlock)
      end
    end
  end)
  local level = self.m_model:GetLevel()
  if level >= AdventureActivityModel.PopUnlockWindowLevel then
    GM.ModeViewController:GetAdventureActivityBoardView():SetWaitLock(1)
    seq:AppendInterval(0.7)
    seq:AppendCallback(function()
      if canScroll or unlockedFog then
        GM.UIManager:SetEventLock(false, self)
      end
      if self.m_closed then
        return
      end
      if self.gameObject:IsNull() then
        return
      end
      if GM.UIManager:GetOpenedViewByName(UIPrefabConfigName.AdventureActivityUnlockWindow) then
        GM.ModeViewController:GetAdventureActivityBoardView():SetWaitLock(-1)
        return
      end
      if self.m_popSwallowWindow then
        GM.ModeViewController:GetAdventureActivityBoardView():SetWaitLock(-1)
        return
      end
      local level = self.m_model:GetLevel()
      if 1 <= level and level ~= self.m_model:GetMergeLength() then
        GM.AudioModel:PlayEffect(AudioFileConfigName.sfxTreasureFound)
        EventDispatcher.DispatchEvent(EEventType.VibrationMedium)
        local itemCode = self.m_model:GetItemCodeByLevel(level)
        local isEnergyBoostWillTutorial = false
        if self.m_model:GetBoardModel():IsEnergyModuleOpen() then
          local curEnergyBoostNum = #self.m_model:GetBoardModel():GetEnergyModel():GetListUnlockExponent()
          if curEnergyBoostNum ~= oriEnergyBoostNum then
            isEnergyBoostWillTutorial = true
          end
        end
        
        local function finishCallback()
          if not self.m_closed and not self.gameObject:IsNull() then
            local updated = self.m_model:TryFogUnlockViewUpdate()
            if updated then
              DelayExecuteFuncInView(function()
                GM.ModeViewController:GetAdventureActivityBoardView():SetWaitLock(-1)
              end, 1.5, self)
            else
              self.m_boardScrollComponentLuaTable:TryScroll()
              GM.ModeViewController:GetAdventureActivityBoardView():SetWaitLock(-1)
            end
          end
        end
        
        if not isEnergyBoostWillTutorial then
          GM.UIManager:OpenView(UIPrefabConfigName.AdventureActivityUnlockWindow, self.m_activityType, itemCode, finishCallback)
        else
          finishCallback()
        end
      end
    end)
    if unlockedFog and level == self.m_model:GetMergeLength() then
      seq:AppendCallback(function()
        if self.m_closed then
          return
        end
        if self.gameObject:IsNull() then
          return
        end
        self.m_model:TryFogUnlockViewUpdate()
      end)
      seq:AppendInterval(2.7)
    end
  else
    if canScroll or unlockedFog then
      GM.UIManager:SetEventLock(false, self)
    end
    self.m_boardScrollComponentLuaTable:TryScroll()
  end
  if self.m_model:IsMaxLevel() then
    GM.UIManager:SetEventLock(true, self)
    seq:AppendCallback(function()
      GM.UIManager:SetEventLock(false, self)
      self:CloseAndOpenNext(self.m_activityDefinition.CompleteWindowPrefabName, self.m_activityType)
      self.m_model:SetNeedPlayChangeTextAni(true)
    end)
  end
end

function ScoreRushModel:_OnItemSpread(message)
  if self:IsFinished() then
    return
  end
  if not self:IsInRace() then
    return
  end
  if message.Source:GetBoardModel() == GM.MainBoardModel and message.CostEnergy then
    local itemType = message.New:GetType()
    local itemChain = GM.ItemDataModel:GetChainId(itemType)
    local config = self.m_itemChainScoreConfig[itemChain]
    if config then
      local level = GM.ItemDataModel:GetChainLevel(itemType)
      if level >= config.level then
        local score = math.floor(config.baseScore * 2 ^ (level - config.level))
        self:_SetCurScore(self:_GetCurScore() + score)
        self:LogActivity(EBIType.ActivityAddScore, GM.BIManager:TableToString({
          a = score,
          g = self:GetCacheGrade(),
          t = itemType
        }))
        EventDispatcher.DispatchEvent(self.m_activityDefinition.MyScoreChangedEvent, {
          Score = score,
          New = message.New
        })
        if GameConfig.IsTestMode() then
          Log.Debug("[ScoreRushModel]\231\167\175\229\136\134\229\162\158\229\138\160\239\188\154" .. score .. ", \229\159\186\229\135\134\239\188\154Lv" .. config.level .. "-" .. config.baseScore .. ", \229\174\158\233\153\133\239\188\154Lv" .. level .. "-" .. score)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function TriggerPlaneModel:_OnItemSpread(message)
  if self:GetDailyStatus() ~= TriggerPlaneDailyStatus.Activated or self:GetState() ~= ActivityState.Started then
    return
  end
  if not message.CostEnergy then
    return
  end
  local itemType = message.New:GetType()
  local itemChain = GM.ItemDataModel:GetChainId(itemType)
  local config = self.m_ItemGenerateScoreConfig[itemChain]
  if config == nil then
    return
  end
  local level = GM.ItemDataModel:GetChainLevel(itemType)
  if level < config.Level then
    return
  end
  local score = config.BaseScore * 2 ^ (level - config.Level)
  score = math.floor(score + 0.5)
  self:AddScore(score, message.New)
end

function TriggerProgressActivityModel:_OnItemSpread(message)
  if not self:IsTriggerOnGoing() then
    return
  end
  if self.m_config.m_triggerProgressCfg.score_type ~= TriggerProgressActivityModel.ScoreType.chance then
    return
  end
  if message.Source:GetBoardModel() == GM.MainBoardModel and message.CostEnergy then
    local clickLeft = self:GetRemainClickNum()
    local getScoreLeft = self:GetRemainGetScoreNum()
    if clickLeft <= 0 then
      clickLeft = self.m_config.m_triggerProgressCfg.chance[1]
      getScoreLeft = self.m_config.m_triggerProgressCfg.chance[2]
      self:SetRemainGetScoreNum(getScoreLeft)
    end
    local bScore = false
    if 0 < getScoreLeft then
      local roll = math.random(1, clickLeft)
      if getScoreLeft >= roll then
        bScore = true
        getScoreLeft = getScoreLeft - 1
        self:SetRemainGetScoreNum(getScoreLeft)
      end
    end
    clickLeft = clickLeft - 1
    self:SetRemainClickNum(clickLeft)
    if bScore then
      local addScore = MathUtil.IntPow(2, message.EnergyBoostRatio)
      self:_AddScore(addScore, TriggerProgressActivityModel.ScoreType.chance, message.Source)
    end
  end
end
